Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 220,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.
 Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.
 Currently looking for a Java Developer to join our team!
 Job Responsibilities: 
 • Design, develop, and maintain backend systems and APIs using Java 11 and above, ensuring high
 performance, reliability, and scalability.
 • Build and enhance microservices-based architectures leveraging Spring Boot.
 • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including frontend developers, DevOps, and product managers, to deliver end-to-end solutions.
 • Integrate backend services with user interfaces built in React, supporting seamless application experiences.
 • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code following industry best practices and HCLTech’s quality standards.
 • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and debugging to optimize application performance and address technical challenges.
 • Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies.
 • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends to ensure HCLTech remains at the forefront of technology innovation.
 Required qualifications: 
 • Proven 6+ years experience as a Software Engineer or Backend Developer, with proficiency in Java 11 and above. (Java 18 and Java 21 preferred) 
 • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and hands-on experience with Spring Boot .
 • Solid experience in developing RESTful APIs and integrating with various data sources.
 • Advanced beginner-level proficiency in React for basic UI integration and troubleshooting.
 • Familiarity with software development lifecycle, version control (e.g., Git), and agile methodologies.
 • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently or as part of a team.
 • Experience designing and implementing asynchronous, event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka and Java messaging/concurrency frameworks.
 • Strong hands-on experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and maintainable Java applications.
 Nice to have: 
 • Experience with Kotlin is a strong plus.
 • Exposure to DevOps practices and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is desirable.
 • Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines is advantageous.
 • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
 Why Us? 
We are investing in your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at every level to help you find your spark;
We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good work-life balance and real flexibility;
Our company is extremely diverse with representation of 165 nationalities;
We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues across the globe;
We offer comprehensive benefits for all employees;
We are a certified great place to work and a top employer in 25 countries including Romania, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect;
 What do we offer? 
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform
25 vacation days/year.
Life Insurance cover.
The employees working on bank holidays will benefit either a paid day off in the next 30 days + 100% of the hourly base salary for that specific day OR 200% of the hourly base salary for that specific day.
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to pregnant employees.
Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
